messages:
pagerbot: PagerDuty alert fired: high 5xx rate on inference-gateway-prod (rate > 15% over 1m). pd_incident=INC-7213. Details: https://pd.example/INC-7213 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Automated page to @maria, @devon, @lee (policy: primary-oncall).
maria: seeing it in metrics, spike started ~7213456600, looks like increased 502s from edge->gateway. Investigating logs.
devon: I can take initial triage. Checking gateway logs now. quick check: us-west1 looks worse than eu.
lee: tagging net/logs team in case it's connection resets. :eyes:
devon: logs show a surge of upstream 522 from inference-workers pool A. Stack traces point to k/v cache miss + backend retry flood.
ops-sre: running routing fallback to canary variant for 10% of traffic to reduce pressure. Command: `infra route swap --svc inference-gateway --to canary-variant --weight 10`
maria: applied route swap, watching latency + 5xx. Cloudwatch shows drop from 18% -> 12% in 30s. Good signal.
devon: also enabling shorter client retries at edge to reduce retry amplification: `edge-config set retry_count=1`
lee: quick customer impact check: top affected customers show increased latencies, one high-volume customer (acct-834) saw errors in critical paths. CS notified.
maria: can we warm the KV cache? If misses are causing load, warming hot prefixes could help.
devon: kicking a cache-warm job to primary pool (script run by me):
```
# warm prefixes from hot_keys backlog
python tools/cache_warm.py --keys-file /tmp/hot_keys.json --concurrency 8
```

ops-sre: cache warm started, ETA ~40s.
pagerbot: PD update: INC-7213 acknowledged by devon at 7213456950. Current status: in mitigation.
maria: monitoring shows 5xx down to 6% after warm + routing. Gradually rolling canary back to 0% over next 5m if stable.
lee: leaving note for followup postmortem: verify autoscaler behavior during kvcache storm and consider backpressure in worker process.
devon: handing off to night oncall (maria) at 7213460000. I'll add runbook steps to incident doc: https://wiki.redwood/INC-7213-runbook
maria: ack handoff, I'll keep watch for 30m and update customers. Closing PD incident when stable for 10m. :white_check_mark:
